670:t_1:171.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Yeah... I'll wait. As long as it takes.」

670:t_1:172.en:
$$ランカ$$
「So... promise you'll come back, $$アルト$$.」

670:t_1:174.en:
???
「To think the result would betray my predictions...」

670:t_1:177.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Girl with the spring-green hair. You alone are not permitted to be happy.」

670:t_1:178.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! When did you get onto the $$クォーター$$!」

670:t_1:180.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You must pay the price for betraying the girl with the pale pink and gold hair.」

670:t_1:183.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I'm sorry, $$アルト$$... You're busy too, and I'm making you put up with my selfishness...」

670:t_1:184.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry about it. In a situation like this, anyone would be anxious.」

670:t_1:185.en:
$$アルト$$
「Besides, the Major asked me to look after you, too.」

670:t_1:186.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You're keeping me company because Big Bro told you to...?」

670:t_1:188.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...You're kind, $$アルト$$... But sometimes... that hurts...」

670:t_1:190.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry... But I... I think I'm at my limit...」

670:t_1:191.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I know it's unfair to do this where $$シェリル$$ can't see... But if I'm going to die here anyway...」

670:t_1:192.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stop it, $$ランカ$$. Don't give up hope.」

670:t_1:193.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I... I love you, $$アルト$$!」

670:t_1:200.en:
$$ランカ$$
「It's funny, isn't it... Hearing how you feel, $$アルト$$, is so much scarier... than singing in the middle of a battle...」

670:t_1:204.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The seeds of hatred and jealousy finally bear fruit. I've come to fetch you, girl with the spring-green hair.」

670:t_1:205.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! When did you get onto the $$クォーター$$!」

670:t_1:207.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, come with me. Along with your unrequited feelings.」

670:t_2:3.en: ～ $$フロンティア船団$$ $$バトル・フロンティア$$ Bridge ～

670:t_2:5.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「The fusion of the $$クィーン$$ and $$バトル・フロンティア$$ is almost complete.」

670:t_2:6.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Since we're using wired cables, even $$熱気バサラ$$'s fold waves shouldn't be able to interfere.」

670:t_2:7.en:
$$三島$$
「And there's still no word on $c...」

670:t_2:8.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Our original plan was to have them wipe out the $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest first, and then carry out our plan. Oh well.」

670:t_2:9.en:
$$三島$$
「It doesn't matter. With the power of the $$バジュラ$$, even they are nothing to fear.」

670:t_2:10.en:
$$三島$$
「In the worst case, I'll simply attempt a transfer to a parallel world.」

670:t_2:11.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「What do you intend to do about Miss $$ストライカー#pilot$$?」

670:t_2:12.en:
$$三島$$
「She is a capable system. Of course, I'll have her work to the end as a soldier building my ideal society.」

670:t_2:13.en:
$$三島$$
「And what is most wonderful about her is...」

670:t_2:15.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「...What is this supposed to be?」

670:t_2:16.en:
$$三島$$
「Don't play dumb, $$グレイス・ゴドゥヌワ$$. You said you were the sole survivor of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$, but that was a lie, wasn't it?」

670:t_2:18.en:
$$三島$$
「My men have already captured or eliminated the $$インプラント$$ soldiers under your command.」

670:t_2:19.en:
$$三島$$
「It's a shame. If you had been a sincere collaborator of mine, none of this would have been necessary.」

670:t_2:20.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「You intend to eliminate me?」

670:t_2:21.en:
$$三島$$
「It's pointless to try to run. I've already stationed troops on this bridge as well.」

670:t_2:22.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「$$レオン・三島$$... It seems I underestimated you.」

670:t_2:23.en:
$$三島$$
「The days of humiliation since the $$再世戦争$$ made me stronger. I may even have to thank $c for that.」

670:t_2:24.en:
$$三島$$
「Then this is farewell, $$グレイス・ゴドゥヌワ$$.」

670:t_2:25.en:
$$三島$$
「With the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ gone, if you lose that body, you won't even be able to load your backed-up memories into another one.」

670:t_2:27.en:
$$三島$$
「If you're going to have a machine body anyway, I wish you had had the purity of Miss $$ストライカー#pilot$$.」

670:t_2:28.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Not... in a place... like this...」

670:t_2:29.en:
$$三島$$
「...I learn, too. Don't think I would let myself be used twice.」

670:t_2:30.en:
$$新統合軍兵$$
「What should we do with this woman?」

670:t_2:31.en:
$$三島$$
「I have no use for a broken machine. Dispose of it.」

670:t_2:33.en:
$$三島$$
「...Now no one stands in the way of my path to supremacy.」

670:t_2:34.en:
$$三島$$
「Soon, the ruler of this galaxy will be decided. And the universe will enter a new era!」

670:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Two older brothers risking their lives to take on the enemy and save their little sister $$ランカ$$...」

670:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z that their feelings produced... I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

670:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't forget, $$ランカ$$... that you and your songs are protected by many people...」

670:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that I have time to say that kind of thing this time either, because the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business!」

670:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion, but I'll give it my all again today... business, business!」

uncertain: Mikage's hair-color epithets (若草色/薄紅と金) rendered literally as fresh-green / pale-rose and golden (Ranka / Sheryl)
2:8 彼等 = 'them' (the Z team); '$c' not used since Japanese has no code
Grace speaker line uses #pilot variant; Striker with 嬢 = 'Miss' + #pilot token
2:25/2:31 Mishima's '機械' lines kept literal; 廃棄しろ = 'Dispose of it'
